name: Witch-King of Angmar
creator: kaizen
description:
**Features:**

- Custom model and textures

- Support for all quality settings
- Custom Voice-over for all languages
- Somew VFX
- Custom loading screen
- Animated Cape
- A shiny new ring, just take it bro, don't worry about it


Leader of the Nine, Sauron's most fearsome servant, the Witch-King of Angmar arrives on the Rift to seek those who would oppose the Dark Lord. Do not come between the Nazgûl and its prey.



The 2.0 update is essentially a remake of the mod. I haven't made custom animations for it (except for laugh, but it's nothing special), since Viego's were already matching very well. However, there is a new, this time movie accurate model, with better looking textures too, a fully animated cape, custom greatsword that's on fire, vfx of the sword attacks were changed to look like fire, Sauron's sigil now appears when possessing someone, and your screen gets a misty green overlay when standing in your E. You also swap out the helmet for Witch-King's "human"crown when in the mist or when recalling. The voice over stays the same, but it's now integrated into the main file, so no need to download anything else.
